images.heading: TCP three-way handshake
images.label: Understand
images.caption: Each endpoint sends a SYN and receives an acknowledgement before the connection is established.
images.alt: Three messages appear between client and server: SYN, SYN plus ACK, then ACK.

images.heading: The water cycle
images.label: Understand
images.layout: labelled three-reservoir cycle with state-change annotations
images.caption: Liquid evaporates into vapour, condensation forms cloud droplets, and precipitation returns water to the surface.
images.alt: Arrows connect surface water to cloud droplets through evaporation and condensation, then to rain and collection.
